title: Monitor GuardDuty Alerts
description: Check GuardDuty alerts for any anomalous behavior related to the stopped access key.
recommended_next_focus: Discover if there are any external threats targeting the user or their resources.

title: Review IAM Activity History
description: Examine the IAM activity history for the user 'admin-test' to find any recent access attempts.
recommended_next_focus: Identify if there are any new or suspicious IAM activities since the access key became inactive.

title: Review CloudTrail Logs
description: Search through CloudTrail logs for any events related to the stopped access key to gather additional context.
recommended_next_focus: Find out if the access key was used during the time period when it was active.
